title: The Angel and the Little Scroll

questions.question: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a ____, with a ____ over his head...
questions.explanation: Revelation 10:1 (ESV): "Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow over his head, and his face was like the sun, and his legs like pillars of fire."

questions.question: He had a little ____ open in his hand. And he set his right foot on the ____, and his left foot on the ____,
questions.explanation: Revelation 10:2 (ESV): "He had a little scroll open in his hand. And he set his right foot on the sea, and his left foot on the land,"

questions.question: and called out with a loud voice, like a lion roaring. When he called out, the seven ____ sounded.
questions.explanation: Revelation 10:3 (ESV): "and called out with a loud voice, like a lion roaring. When he called out, the seven thunders sounded."

questions.question: And when the seven thunders had sounded, I was about to write, but I heard a voice from heaven saying, "____ what the seven thunders have said, and do not write it down."
questions.explanation: Revelation 10:4 (ESV): "And when the seven thunders had sounded, I was about to write, but I heard a voice from heaven saying, 'Seal up what the seven thunders have said, and do not write it down.'"

questions.question: And the angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land raised his ____ hand to heaven
questions.explanation: Revelation 10:5 (ESV): "And the angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven"

questions.question: and swore by him who lives forever and ever... that there would be no more ____,
questions.explanation: Revelation 10:6 (ESV): "and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and what is in it, the earth and what is in it, and the sea and what is in it, that there would be no more delay,"

questions.question: but that in the days of the trumpet call to be sounded by the seventh angel, the ____ of God would be fulfilled, just as he announced to his servants the prophets.
questions.explanation: Revelation 10:7 (ESV): "but that in the days of the trumpet call to be sounded by the seventh angel, the mystery of God would be fulfilled, just as he announced to his servants the prophets."

questions.question: Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me again, saying, "Go, take the scroll that is open in the hand of the ____ who is standing on the sea and on the land."
questions.explanation: Revelation 10:8 (ESV): "Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me again, saying, 'Go, take the scroll that is open in the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the land.'"

questions.question: So I went to the angel and told him to give me the little scroll. And he said to me, "Take and ____ it; it will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be sweet as honey."
questions.explanation: Revelation 10:9 (ESV): "So I went to the angel and told him to give me the little scroll. And he said to me, 'Take and eat it; it will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be sweet as honey.'"

questions.question: How did the little scroll taste in John's mouth?
questions.explanation: Revelation 10:10 (ESV): "And I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. It was sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I had eaten it my stomach was made bitter."

questions.question: What happened to John's stomach after he ate the little scroll?
questions.explanation: Revelation 10:10 (ESV): "And I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. It was sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I had eaten it my stomach was made bitter."

questions.question: And I was told, "You must again ____ about many peoples and nations and languages and kings."
questions.explanation: Revelation 10:11 (ESV): "And I was told, 'You must again prophesy about many peoples and nations and languages and kings.'"

questions.question: The angel who had the little scroll swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created ____ and what is in it, the ____ and what is in it, and the ____ and what is in it.
questions.explanation: Revelation 10:6 (ESV): "and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and what is in it, the earth and what is in it, and the sea and what is in it, that there would be no more delay,"

questions.question: What feature of the mighty angel was "like the sun"?
questions.explanation: Revelation 10:1 (ESV): "Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow over his head, and his face was like the sun, and his legs like pillars of fire."

questions.question: What feature of the mighty angel was "like pillars of fire"?
questions.explanation: Revelation 10:1 (ESV): "Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow over his head, and his face was like the sun, and his legs like pillars of fire."

key_verse_text: but that in the days of the trumpet call to be sounded by the seventh angel, the mystery of God would be fulfilled, just as he announced to his servants the prophets.
